newsitem.title: USA: Baca named interim U.S. land agency director.
newsitem.headline: Baca named interim U.S. land agency director.

text.p: Sylvia Baca was named Tuesday as interim director of the U.S. Bureau of Land Management (BLM), the Interior Department said.
Interior Secretary Bruce Babbitt named her to succeed Michael Dombeck, who left the agency last week to become chief of the U.S. Forest Service in the Agriculture Department.

Baca, from New Mexico, is currently deputy assistant secretary for land and minerals management, overseeing BLM, the Minerals Management Service, and the Office of Surface Mining Reclamation. She will return to the position after a permanent BLM Director is chosen.
BLM manages 265 million acres of public land, mainly in the western states and Alaska.
Baca is no relation of Jim Baca, a controversial former head of BLM from 1993 to February 1994.
